"""Sequential CPU-only matched reward pilots; require a current regression receipt."""
import copy,hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
from emet.rl.regression_gate import verify_regressions
from emet.rl.manipulation.hold_experiment import training_command
receipt=Path('paper/data/whole_body_control/hold-cartesian-clock-v7-regressions-20261025.receipt.json')
verified=verify_regressions(receipt)
spec_path=Path('configs/benchmarks/mars_hold_training_feedback_v6.json');spec=json.loads(spec_path.read_text())
assert spec['steps']==16384 and spec['eval_every']==4096 and spec['environment']['goal_gated_settling'] is True
out=Path('logs/manipulation/tamp-goal-gated-precision-v10');out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
source=spec['initializers']['tracking_feedback'];variants=[]
for name,gated in [('control',False),('goal_gated',True)]:
 s=copy.deepcopy(spec);s['environment']['goal_gated_settling']=gated
 directory=out/name;directory.mkdir();command=training_command(s,directory,source,'offline')
 (directory/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(s,indent=2)+'\n');(directory/'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(command,indent=2)+'\n')
 variants.append({'name':name,'spec':s,'command':command,'directory':str(directory)})
launch={'format':'mars-pose-research-launch-v2','started_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'source_revision':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),
 'source_state':verified['source_state'],'spec_sha256':hashlib.sha256(spec_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'variants':variants,'output':str(out),'regression_receipt':str(receipt),
 'regression_receipt_sha256':hashlib.sha256(receipt.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'regression_tests':len(verified['test_ids']),'cpu_affinity':[14],
 'completed_steps_at_launch':0,'training_complete':False,'safety_promoted':False,
 'scope':'Two sequential 16384-step simulator research pilots, same initial weights/seed/limits; no hardware, online W&B, upload or promotion',
 'source_weights_sha256':json.loads((Path(source)/'manifest.json').read_text())['weights_sha256'],
 'driver_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'evaluation_driver_source':Path('/tmp/evaluate_goal_gated_pair_20261025.py').read_text()}
(out/'launch.json').write_text(json.dumps(launch,indent=2)+'\n')
Path('paper/data/whole_body_control/pose_goal_gated_refinement_v6_launch.json').write_text(json.dumps(launch,indent=2)+'\n')
print('REGRESSION_VERIFIED',len(verified['test_ids']),'START',str(out),flush=True)
for v in variants:
 # A code change between pilots must not silently change the comparison.
 verify_regressions(receipt)
 print('START_VARIANT',v['name'],flush=True)
 with (Path(v['directory'])/'train.log').open('w') as log:
  result=subprocess.run(v['command'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 status={'returncode':result.returncode,'finished_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
 (Path(v['directory'])/'exit.json').write_text(json.dumps(status)+'\n')
 print('TRAIN_RETURN',v['name'],result.returncode,flush=True)
 if result.returncode:raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
(out/'complete.json').write_text(json.dumps({'variants':2,'steps_per_variant':16384,'promoted':False,'finished_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()})+'\n')

# Evaluate only completed runs, sequentially on the same CPU after all training.
verify_regressions(receipt)
evaluator=out/'evaluate.py'
evaluator.write_text(launch['evaluation_driver_source'])
result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(evaluator)])
(out/'evaluation_exit.json').write_text(json.dumps({'returncode':result.returncode,'finished_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()})+'\n')
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)

"""Matched completed-policy diagnostics and frozen public TAMP replay; never promote."""
import gzip,hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
import torch
from emet.eval.mars_policy_audit import stationary_trial,sources
from emet.eval.mars_hold_dynamics import quiet_metrics
from emet.eval.mars_tamp_sequences import run_sequence,manifest
from emet.eval.mars_tamp_control import CANONICAL_SUITE
from emet.rl.manipulation.hold_experiment import evidence
from emet.rl.manipulation.env import ManipulationConfig
from emet.rl.regression_gate import verify_regressions

torch.set_num_threads(1)
receipt=Path('paper/data/whole_body_control/hold-cartesian-clock-v7-regressions-20261025.receipt.json')
verify_regressions(receipt)
root=Path('logs/manipulation/tamp-goal-gated-precision-v10');assert (root/'complete.json').exists()
out=Path('logs/eval/goal-gated-pair-v10-20261025');out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
catalog={c['id']:c for c in json.loads(CANONICAL_SUITE.read_text())['cases']}
program=json.loads(Path('configs/benchmarks/mars_tamp_policy_development_v1.json').read_text())
report={'scope':'Matched two 16384-step reward pilots from identical weights/seed; simulator development only','source_hashes':sources(),'tamp_sources':manifest(),'variants':{},'driver_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'safety_promoted':False,'complete':False}
def save():
 s={k:v for k,v in report.items() if k not in ['driver_source','source_hashes','tamp_sources','variants']}
 s['variants']={}
 for name,v in report['variants'].items():
  s['variants'][name]={'checkpoint':v['checkpoint'],'pose_rows':[{k:x for k,x in r.items() if k not in ['trace','warmup_trace','initial_state']} for r in v['pose_rows']],
   'programs':[{'case_id':e['case']['id'],'completed_stages':e['completed_stages'],'policy_calls':e['policy_calls'],'robot_failure':e['robot_failure'],'stop_confirmed':e['stop_confirmed'],'failure_measurement':{k:x for k,x in e['events'][-1].items() if k in ['reason','position_error_m','orientation_error_rad']}} for e in v['programs']]}
 (out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(s,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
for name in ['control','goal_gated']:
 base=root/name/'seed-64';assert (base/'complete.json').exists();run=json.loads((base/'run.json').read_text());cfg=ManipulationConfig(**run['env'])
 manifests={p.name:json.loads((p/'manifest.json').read_text()) for p in base.glob('step-*')}
 evdir=out/name;evdir.mkdir();ev=evidence(evdir,cfg,manifests,training_run=run)
 final=base/'step-16384';v={'checkpoint':str(final),'evidence':str(ev),'training_run':run,'pose_rows':[],'programs':[]};report['variants'][name]=v
 for case in ['left:20g:1','right:20g:2']:
  for kind,delta in [('hold',None),('nearby',[0,-.05,0,0,0]),('rotation',[0,0,0,0,.12])]:
   r=stationary_trial(catalog[case],final,ev,selector='checkpoint_policy',joint_delta=delta,duration_s=6)
   r.update(case_id=case,kind=kind,duration_requested_s=6,tamp_quiet_metrics=quiet_metrics(r.get('trace',[]),retention_context=True,position_tolerance_m=.003,orientation_tolerance_rad=.02))
   r['tamp_endpoint_pass']=not r.get('failure') and r.get('hand_error_at_end_m',1)<=.003 and r.get('orientation_error_at_end_rad',1)<=.02 and r.get('quiet_at_end',False)
   v['pose_rows'].append(r);save();print('POSE',name,case,kind,r.get('failure'),r.get('hand_error_at_end_m'),r.get('orientation_error_at_end_rad'),r['tamp_endpoint_pass'],flush=True)
 for case in program['cases']:
  ep=run_sequence(catalog[case],program['program'],policy_directory=final,policy_evidence=ev,record_observations=False,arm_execution='cartesian')
  v['programs'].append(ep);save();print('TAMP',name,case,ep['completed_stages'],ep['policy_calls'],ep.get('robot_failure'),flush=True)
# Verify the paired physical resets rather than silently comparing different cases.
for a,b in zip(report['variants']['control']['programs'],report['variants']['goal_gated']['programs']):
 assert a['case']['id']==b['case']['id'] and a['initial_state']['qpos']==b['initial_state']['qpos']
report['matched_initial_physics']=True;report['complete']=True
raw=(json.dumps(report,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n').encode();archive=out/'report.json.gz';archive.write_bytes(gzip.compress(raw,mtime=0));save()
s=json.loads((out/'summary.json').read_text());s.update(full_report_archive=str(archive),uncompressed_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest());(out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(s,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
print('MATCHED_EVALUATION_COMPLETE',flush=True)
